{{Quote|This is Captain Shenes of His Imperial Majesty's Star Destroyer Fist of the Empire! We are taking heavy damage. We will keep fighting as long as we can. Any assistance we could receive with these Annihilators would be appreciated. We live to serve the true Emperor!|Captain Shenes|<ref name="War 5" />}}
The '''''Fist of the Empire''''' was a [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Empire-in-exile|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[138 ABY]], under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shenes]], the ''Fist of the Empire'' participated on the allied [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|assault]] against [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] alongside [[Roan Fel|Fel]]-loyalist [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] such as the ''[[War Hammer]]'' and the [[Core Fleet|fleet]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. During the battle, however, the ''Fist of the Empire'' suffered heavy damage from [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Annihilator-class starfighter|''Annihilator''-class starfighters]]. Though Captain Shenes requested assistance, the starship was destroyed shortly afterwards.
